{{Top|leg}}
'''Search, Locate, Annihilate Missions''', or '''SLAMs''', were a type of military operation used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The goal of a SLAM was typically the region-wide elimination of production assets. The [[First Sun Mobile Regiment]], a group of mercenaries primarily working for the Galactic Empire, were specialists in SLAMs to the point that, even after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], they would still be hired to do SLAMs by totalitarian governments.

==Behind the scenes==
The term "Search, Locate, Annihilate Mission" and its acronym "SLAM" were both introduced in the description of the First Sun Mobile Regiment in the RPG article ''[[Special Military Unit Intelligence Update]]''. The article is written in an in-universe perspective - more specifically in the perspective of a [[Zgorth'sth]].
